questions.q: How many main beats are in a bar of 6/8?
questions.why: 6/8 is compound duple: two dotted-crotchet beats, each dividing into three.

options: a steady beat on every crotchet
accents on weak beats or off the beat
questions.why: Syncopation displaces accents to weak or off-beats.

questions.q: What is the difference between simple and compound time?
questions.model: In simple time each beat divides into two; in compound time each beat divides into three.
